label: Basketball

criteria.label: Shooting arm extension
criteria.look_for: arm fully extended at release, elbow under the ball, not flaring out
criteria.drill: Form shooting from 1 m: hold the follow-through until the ball lands.

criteria.label: Arm elevation
criteria.look_for: ball released high, above the forehead, shooting arm driving up
criteria.drill: Wall shots: release the ball at the highest point you can reach.

criteria.label: Upright balance
criteria.look_for: shoulders over hips, no fade, drift or lean at release
criteria.drill: Land on the spot you jumped from, 10 reps, mark the floor.

criteria.label: Leg extension
criteria.look_for: legs extending through the jump, power coming from the base
criteria.drill: Pause-dip shots: sit into the knees, then drive up through the release.

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Judge only the shot motion of the target: base, shot pocket, release, follow-through.
